The document says "electromagnetic meter". Later it says "The water meter is produced at..." — that's probably a typo in the certificate (they reused text). I'll use "Electromagnetic meter" as category. Actually for R117, these are typically "flow meter" or "metering instruments". Let me use "Electromagnetic meter".

Type designations: OPTIFLUX x300C, OPTIFLUX x000F, IFC300y. The footnote says x ∈ {1, 2, 4, 5, 6}, y ∈ {F, W}. So actual types: OPTIFLUX 1300C, 2300C, 4300C, 5300C, 6300C; OPTIFLUX 1000F, 2000F, 4000F, 5000F, 6000F + IFC300F / IFC300W.

Module designation: not applicable — actually the signal converter IFC300y is a component. The certified type includes the sensor (OPTIFLUX) plus converter IFC300. Should I record IFC300 as component? The certificate says "Type: OPTIFLUX x300C; OPTIFLUX x000F + IFC300y". So the OPTIFLUX x000F sensor is used with IFC300y converter (remote version).
